items.title: 輝達自由現金流恐遭高估！戰略投資吃掉近七成、2,350億美元回購計畫添變數
paras: 輝達擴大股票回購規模之際，財務數據卻透露出另一個值得關注的訊號。公司近期在公告中加入「扣除戰略用途後的超額自由現金流」一詞，暗示對外股權投資也會影響可用於回購股票及發放股利的資金，凸顯傳統自由現金流指標可能無法完整反映公司的實際財務狀況。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，輝達9月28日宣布將股票回購授權額度增加1,500億美元，總額提高至2,350億美元。
不過，若將戰略股權投資及員工股權激勵相關現金支出納入考量，輝達今年上半財年的實際自由現金流，可能從官方公布的699億美元降至約217億美元，減幅約69%。
與此同時，輝達上半財年投入約310億美元進行超出維持股本規模所需的額外股票回購，長期債務也增加249億美元至324億美元。
這些數字引發市場對公司回購計畫能否持續，以及實際可供股東分配的現金規模是否遭高估的疑慮。

戰略投資改變自由現金流的解讀方式

傳統上，自由現金流通常以營業活動現金流減去資本支出計算，用來衡量企業維持日常營運及必要投資後，還有多少現金可以靈活運用。
然而，輝達的資金用途已不再侷限於廠房、設備等傳統資本支出，還包括對人工智慧（AI）生態系統內企業的股權投資。
輝達目前持有13家上市公司及229家未上市公司的股權，投資領域涵蓋資料中心建設、AI模型開發、能源供應及硬體製造，包括OpenAI與Anthropic等AI業者。
輝達將這類投資視為戰略布局，認為有助於加速自身運算平台及整體AI市場發展，而非單純可有可無的資金配置。
問題在於，部分獲得輝達投資的企業，同時也是輝達晶片的客戶。資金從輝達流向這些企業後，可能再透過採購晶片等方式回流至輝達，形成相互依存的商業關係，也讓市場更加關注AI產業投資熱潮的可持續性。

扣除投資與股權激勵支出後，自由現金流剩多少？

根據《華爾街日報》分析，截至7月26日的上半財年，輝達股權投資的現金流出達424億美元，出售股權投資則帶來72億美元收入，兩者相抵後，淨現金流出為352億美元。
若將這筆淨流出視同資本支出，輝達的自由現金流將從官方公布的699億美元降至347億美元，已減少約一半。
此外，員工股權激勵也涉及額外現金支出。輝達同期為員工股票歸屬支付45億美元的現金預扣稅款，另有約90億美元股票回購用於抵銷股權激勵造成的股本稀釋。
將股權投資淨流出與員工股權激勵相關現金支出一併納入計算後，輝達上半財年的調整後自由現金流僅約217億美元，較官方數字減少69%。

2,350億美元回購計畫，面臨現金流考驗

輝達將股票回購授權額度擴大至2,350億美元，規模相當可觀，能否實際執行，仍取決於未來現金流能否持續成長，以及公司如何在股東回報與戰略投資之間分配資金。
根據Visible Alpha彙整的華爾街分析師預測，輝達2028會計年度，也就是截至2028年1月的會計年度，自由現金流平均預估將超過3,300億美元。若依照傳統計算方式，這筆現金理論上足以支應全部股票回購授權額度及股利支出。
不過，若輝達持續投入大量資金扶植AI生態系統內的企業，實際可供股東分配的現金就可能低於傳統自由現金流數字所呈現的水準，進而壓縮回購計畫的執行空間。
值得注意的是，輝達同期增加249億美元長期債務，也反映公司在進行戰略投資及其他現金支出的同時，仍維持大規模額外回購所面臨的資金配置壓力。

輝達提高資訊透明度，仍有改善空間

在財務資訊揭露方面，輝達近期已調整現金流量表的呈現方式，將債務類證券與股權類證券分開列示。
由於公司持有的債務證券均為美國公債或機構債券，這項調整讓投資人更容易辨識股權投資的資金流向，並自行估算相關支出對自由現金流的影響。
相較之下，微軟、亞馬遜及Google母公司Alphabet仍將債務投資與股權投資合併列報，投資人較難從公開財報中直接拆分兩者的現金流。
報導認為，其他企業也應採取類似做法，提升財務資訊的可讀性。
不過，即使輝達已改善揭露方式，傳統自由現金流仍未完整涵蓋所有影響股東回報能力的資金用途。對投資人而言，
評估輝達的財務實力與股票回購能力時，除了關注官方公布的自由現金流，也需要檢視戰略投資、股權激勵及債務變化，才能更全面掌握公司實際可運用的現金規模。

items.title: 特斯拉漲逾2% 分析師：布局實體AI最直接標的之一
items.title_en: Tesla Rises Over 2% Analyst: One of the Most Direct Real‑AI Plays
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，長期看多特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)的分析師Dan Ives再次強調，特斯拉本質上是一家人工智慧公司，而不只是電動車製造商。
這位曾任職Wedbush、目前擔任Yorkville Ives的資深分析師，在致客戶的報告中重申對特斯拉的「優於大盤」評級，並維持500美元目標價。他認為，自動駕駛、機器人計程車(Robotaxi)與Optimus人形機器人，將愈來愈成為決定特斯拉價值的主要因素。
Ives寫道，「我們認為，特斯拉是公開市場上最直接布局實體AI的標的之一。」特斯拉股價周五(9日)上漲逾2%。
從Ives的觀點來看，特斯拉已將多數AI與機器人計畫仍仰賴外部合作夥伴提供的關鍵要素，整合在同一家公司內：數百萬輛車所構成的車隊，持續產生駕駛數據，負責從這些數據中學習的AI模型與自研晶片，以及能夠大規模生產相關產品的製造能力。
他表示，「如果投資人主要將特斯拉視為一家電動車製造商來估值，就只看到了它的車隊，卻忽略了正在以此為基礎打造的平台。」
Ives將全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)視為連結現有電動車業務與未來自動駕駛業務的橋梁。FSD訂閱服務已開始提高每輛車帶來的軟體營收，而在北美新售電動車中，FSD的選用率已超過55%。
特斯拉的Robotaxi服務目前已在美國六座城市營運，付費行駛里程接近250萬英里。且內華達州核發的5,000輛車許可，也為擴大車隊規模提供了空間。專為無人駕駛打造、沒有方向盤與踏板的Cybercab已開始生產，並在奧斯汀載送付費乘客。
Ives表示，投資人接下來應關注的是車隊規模。他指出，「當無人監督的自動駕駛車輛從數十輛增加到數千輛，自動駕駛就會從一種潛在成長機會，轉變為實際營收來源。」
Ives採用以2028年營收預估為基礎的分類加總估值法(SOTP)，推算特斯拉的股價相當於營收的12.2倍，遠高於同業約5.3倍的中位數。依照他的估算，若只把特斯拉視為電動車公司，其現有業務每股價值約165美元，其餘335美元則來自自動駕駛與Optimus機器人業務。
這意味著，他所設定的特斯拉目標價中，約三分之二押注在仍於發展初期的業務上。Ives指出，目前德州僅45輛Cybercab獲准以無人駕駛方式營運，特斯拉本身也預期，第一年在內華達州投入營運的車輛約2,500輛，僅是許可的一半。此外，特斯拉第二季營運更新中，已將Cybertruck與Optimus從2026年量產清單中移除。
監管也是可能阻礙成長的另一項因素。美國國家公路交通安全管理局(NHTSA)已針對Cybercab的自行認證程序發布特別命令，要求特斯拉說明其自我認證情況，特斯拉原本須於9月30日前提交宣誓回覆。目前主管機關尚未公布決定，但若認定結果不利，Cybercab的營運範圍可能受到限制。
另一方面，特斯拉正在加州與德州興建專供Optimus使用的生產設施。不過，Ives也指出，這款機器人的商業化部署時程過去曾多次延後。
Ives寫道，「這條路顯然不會一帆風順，但隨著馬斯克這項顛覆性科技願景逐步成形，投資人需要提前看見未來。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Dan Ives, a long‑time bullish analyst on Tesla (TSLA‑US), reiterated that Tesla is essentially an artificial‑intelligence company, not just an electric‑vehicle manufacturer.

The veteran analyst, formerly of Wedbush and now at Yorkville Ives, restated his “out‑perform” rating on Tesla in a client note and kept his $500 price target. He believes autonomous driving, robotaxi services and the Optimus humanoid robot will increasingly drive Tesla’s valuation.
Ives wrote, “We think Tesla is one of the most direct public‑market plays to gain exposure to real AI.” Tesla’s stock rose more than 2% on Friday the 9th.

From Ives’s perspective, Tesla has consolidated most AI and robotics projects that previously relied on external partners into a single company: a fleet of millions of cars that continuously generate driving data, AI models and in‑house chips that learn from that data, and manufacturing capacity to produce related products at scale.
He said, “If investors mainly value Tesla as an EV maker, they only see the fleet and miss the platform being built on top of it.”

Ives views Full Self‑Driving (FSD) as the bridge between Tesla’s current EV business and its future autonomous‑driving operations. The FSD subscription has begun to lift software revenue per vehicle, and its uptake in new North American EV sales now exceeds 55%.

Tesla’s robotaxi service is already operating in six U.S. cities, with paid‑mileage approaching 2.5 million miles. A Nevada permit for 5,000 vehicles also leaves room to expand the fleet. The steering‑wheel‑ and pedal‑free Cybercab, built for driverless operation, has entered production and is ferrying paying passengers in Austin.

Ives said investors should now focus on fleet size. He noted, “When driverless autonomous cars grow from dozens to thousands, autonomous driving shifts from a potential growth opportunity to an actual revenue source.”

Using a sum‑of‑the‑parts (SOTP) valuation based on 2028 revenue estimates, Ives calculates Tesla’s stock trades at about 12.2 times revenue, far above the industry median of roughly 5.3 times. He estimates that if Tesla were valued only as an EV company, its existing business would be worth about $165 per share, with the remaining $335 coming from autonomous driving and Optimus robot businesses.

That means roughly two‑thirds of his target price is tied to businesses still in early development. Ives noted that only 45 Cybercabs are currently authorized to operate driverlessly in Texas, and Tesla expects about 2,500 vehicles to be deployed in Nevada in the first year—only half of the permitted amount. Additionally, Tesla’s Q2 operating update removed Cybertruck and Optimus from the 2026 mass‑production roadmap.

Regulation is another potential growth constraint. The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has issued a special order on Cybercab’s self‑certification process, demanding Tesla explain its self‑certification status, with a sworn response originally due by Sept. 30. The agency has not yet ruled, but an adverse finding could limit Cybercab’s operating scope.
Meanwhile, Tesla is building dedicated production facilities for Optimus in California and Texas, though Ives cautioned that the robot’s commercial rollout timeline has been delayed repeatedly.
Ives wrote, “The road ahead clearly won’t be smooth, but as Elon Musk’s disruptive‑technology vision gradually takes shape, investors need to see the future ahead of it.”

items.title: 2026諾貝爾文學獎得主安妮卡森：她把古希臘文學寫成了現代人的破碎心事
items.title_en: 2026 Nobel Literature Laureate Anne Carson: She Turns Ancient Greek Literature into Modern Broken Hearts
paras: 瑞典文學院10月8日公布2026年諾貝爾文學獎得主,由加拿大詩人、散文家兼古典學者安妮·卡森(Anne Carson)獲得。文學院表示,卡森獲獎是因為「其大膽且富創造力的作品,以充滿玩味的方式與古典傳統對話,為當代文學創造了新形式」。獎金為1,200萬瑞典克朗(約120萬美元)。

據《BBC》報導,現年76歲的卡森1950年出生於多倫多,現居美國密西根州,2022年起同時擁有冰島公民身分。瑞典文學院常任秘書卡爾伯格(Ingrid Carlberg)在公布前不久致電通知卡森,當時卡森人在冰島。卡爾伯格說,卡森對獲獎感到意外但非常開心。卡森接受冰島國家廣播電台(RUV)訪問時則半開玩笑說,評審們「都瘋了」。加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)在社群平台表示,卡森獲獎是「加拿大的驕傲時刻」。
卡森首先是一名古典學者,長年研究古希臘語言、詩歌與戲劇,並在大學任教逾30年,同時也是一位極具原創性的作家。諾貝爾獎官網的生平介紹指出,她1981年出版古典學博士論文,其後職業生涯始終結合詩歌創作、翻譯與教學,作品多半落在語文學者對字詞的執著,與詩人追求新意義的渴望交會之處。卡森自己也說,字詞的詞源是其所有創作的起點。
據《得到》App專欄介紹,卡森少女時期在購物中心的書店買到一本希臘女詩人薩福(Sappho)的雙語詩集,從此迷上希臘語,並利用午餐時間跟著高中拉丁語老師學習。她後來翻譯的薩福殘篇《If Not, Winter》(2002年),以及索福克勒斯的《厄勒克特拉》(2001年)、《安蒂岡妮》(2015年)和歐里庇得斯的《酒神的伴侶》(2015年),被文學院視為可獨立成篇的創作。

卡森1986年的長篇散文《Eros the Bittersweet》奠定了她日後創作的基礎。書中以薩福筆下兼具痛苦與甜美的愛欲(Eros)為核心,探討愛者與被愛者之間的距離如何推動詩的運行。她在書中提出「立體視覺」的概念,主張同時抱持兩種視角。文學院指出,卡森擅長透過意想不到的組合打破「受敘事自我束縛的抒情詩」,例如在《Economy of the Unlost》(1999年)讓古希臘詩人西莫尼德斯與詩人策蘭(Paul Celan)對話,在《Men in the Off Hours》(2000年)讓歷史學家修昔底德與作家吳爾芙並置。

在代表作方面,1998年出版的詩體小說《Autobiography of Red》(中文版譯為《紅的自傳》)常被視為卡森的最高成就。她以古希臘詩人斯特西克魯斯(Stesichoros)筆下長著翅膀的紅色怪物革律翁(Geryon)為起點,在神話中,革律翁被英雄赫拉克勒斯(Heracles)殺死並被奪走牛群,卡森則將這名可怕的巨人改寫為依戀母親的敏感少年,在現代社會中成長,愛上傲慢粗魯的赫拉克勒斯,成為一部現代成長小說。故事尾聲,成年的革律翁不再隱藏自己的翅膀,獨自飛越火山。文學院形容,這部作品展現了她讓古典文學傳統在當代重新生效的卓越能力。

卡森的其他重要作品還包括1995年《Glass, Irony, and God》收錄的長詩《The Glass Essay》,以被丈夫拋棄的女子探訪孤獨母親的旅程為主線,並穿插對艾蜜莉·勃朗特(Emily Brontë)的閱讀,是一首關於遭遺棄的長詩兼散文;2001年的《The Beauty of the Husband》以29首「探戈」寫一段充滿譏諷與欺瞞的婚姻衝突,每一章都以濟慈(John Keats)的詩句開頭。2010年的《Nox》則是為紀念2000年在丹麥去世的哥哥麥可(Michael)而作,形式是裝在盒中、可展開的摺頁,收有圖片、信件與文字,並引入羅馬詩人卡圖盧斯(Catullus)悼念亡兄的輓歌,由卡森親自翻譯。

卡森的創作形式始終不拘一格。2016年的《Float》由22本可按任意順序閱讀的小冊子組成,2024年的《Wrong Norma》則結合多種文類與表演性質強烈的文本。《BBC》報導指出,她2019年的表演作品《Norma Jeane Baker of Troy》將特洛伊的海倫與瑪麗蓮·夢露相提並論,2021年推出圖像小說《The Trojan Women: A Comic》,而她翻譯的《厄勒克特拉》2025年由布麗·拉森(Brie Larson)主演,在倫敦登台。
諾貝爾文學獎委員會主席奧爾森(Anders Olsson)表示,卡森打破了「受敘事自我束縛的抒情詩」,啟發了當代文學的新形式。他說,她與視覺藝術家、編舞家以及歌劇和戲劇導演的合作,展現了她面對文學期待與規則時的自由,這正是她自1990年代以來的作品,對國際藝術與文學界具有重要意義的原因。
據《得到》App專欄引述,卡森曾表示古希臘語比現代語言更能深入字裡行間,閱讀希臘文時,人彷彿身在字詞的根部,而英語則像在樹梢間跳躍。她的詩風硬朗簡潔,帶有跳躍與斷裂感,光線、水與雪是詩中的核心意象。
據《得到》App專欄分析,卡森長期被視為諾貝爾文學獎熱門人選,且讀者群相對小眾。2025年得主為匈牙利作家克拉斯諾霍凱(László Krasznahorkai)。卡森的作品融合古典學研究、哲學闡釋、小說與視覺藝術,其獲獎將使這位長期以學院與實驗詩壇為根據地的作家,被更廣泛的讀者認識。
paras_en: The Swedish Academy announced on October 8 that the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature goes to Canadian poet, essayist and classicist Anne Carson. The Academy said Carson was awarded for “her bold and inventive work, which engages the classical tradition in a playful way and creates new forms for contemporary literature.” The prize money is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million).

According to the BBC, the 76‑year‑old Carson was born in Toronto in 1950, now lives in Michigan, and has held Icelandic citizenship since 2022. Ingrid Carlberg, the Academy’s permanent secretary, called Carson shortly before the announcement while Carson was in Iceland. Carlberg said Carson was surprised but very happy about the award. In an interview with Icelandic broadcaster RUV, Carson half‑jokingly said the judges “must be crazy.” Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on social media that Carson’s win is “a proud moment for Canada.”

Carson began as a classicist, spending decades studying ancient Greek language, poetry and drama while teaching at universities for more than 30 years, and she is also an exceptionally original writer. The Nobel website notes that she published her doctoral dissertation in classics in 1981, and her career has consistently blended poetry, translation and teaching, landing where a scholar’s obsession with words meets a poet’s hunger for new meaning. Carson herself says that the etymology of words is the starting point of all her work.

According to a profile on the Get‑It‑Done app, Carson bought a bilingual collection of poems by the Greek poet Sappho at a mall bookstore as a teenager, fell in love with Greek, and used lunch breaks to study with her high‑school Latin teacher. Her later translations of Sappho fragments “If Not, Winter” (2002), Sophocles’ “Electra” (2001), “Antigone” (2015) and Euripides’ “The Bacchic Companion” (2015) were considered by the Academy as stand‑alone creations.

Carson’s 1986 long‑form essay “Eros the Bittersweet” laid the groundwork for her later work. The book centers on the painful‑sweet love (Eros) depicted by Sappho and examines how the distance between lover and beloved drives poetic movement. She introduced the concept of “stereoscopic vision,” advocating the holding of two perspectives at once. The Academy notes that Carson breaks “lyric poetry bound by narrative self” through unexpected juxtapositions, such as pairing the ancient Greek poet Simonides with Paul Celan in “Economy of the Unlost” (1999) and placing historian Thucydides beside writer Virginia Woolf in “Men in the Off Hours” (2000).

Among her most celebrated works, the 1998 poetic novel “Autobiography of Red” (Chinese title “紅的自傳”) is often seen as Carson’s masterpiece. She takes the winged red monster Geryon from the ancient poet Stesichorus as a starting point; in myth, Geryon is slain by Heracles and his cattle stolen. Carson reimagines the terrifying giant as a sensitive youth attached to his mother, growing up in modern society and falling for the arrogant, brutish Heracles, turning the myth into a contemporary coming‑of‑age story. In the finale, the adult Geryon no longer hides his wings and flies alone over a volcano. The Academy described the book as showcasing her extraordinary ability to make classical literature function anew today.

Other important titles include the long poem “The Glass Essay” from the 1995 collection “Glass, Irony, and God,” which follows a woman abandoned by her husband as she visits a solitary mother and interweaves readings of Emily Brontë; the 2001 “The Beauty of the Husband,” a sequence of 29 “tangos” that dramatize a marriage riddled with sarcasm and deceit, each chapter opening with a line from John Keats; and the 2010 “Nox,” a box‑bound, unfoldable work created in memory of her brother Michael, who died in Denmark in 2000, incorporating images, letters, texts and Carson’s own translation of Catullus’s elegy for a dead brother.

Carson’s forms are constantly experimental. In 2016 she released “Float,” a set of 22 booklets that can be read in any order, and in 2024 “Wrong Norma” combined multiple genres with highly performative texts. The BBC reported that her 2019 performance piece “Norma Jeane Baker of Troy” juxtaposed Helen of Troy with Marilyn Monroe, that she issued the graphic novel “The Trojan Women: A Comic” in 2021, and that her translation of “Electra” will be staged in London in 2025 starring Brie Larson.

Anders Olsson, chair of the Nobel Literature Committee, said Carson has shattered “lyric poetry constrained by narrative self” and inspired new forms in contemporary literature. He noted her collaborations with visual artists, choreographers, and opera and theatre directors demonstrate her freedom in confronting literary expectations and rules, which has made her work since the 1990s significant for the international art and literary worlds.

Carson has said that ancient Greek can probe deeper into the fabric of words than modern languages; reading Greek feels like standing at the root of a word, whereas English feels like hopping among treetops. Her poetic style is stark and concise, marked by jumps and fractures, with light, water and snow as core images.

According to the Get‑It‑Done app, Carson has long been a perennial Nobel contender but with a relatively niche readership. The 2025 laureate was Hungarian writer László Krasznahorkai. Carson’s blend of classical scholarship, philosophical inquiry, fiction and visual art means her win will introduce this academy‑and‑experimental‑poetry‑based writer to a much broader audience.

items.title: 美債殖利率竄升埋危機？麥格理示警：金融爆雷往往緊隨劇烈波動
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Hiding a Crisis? Macquarie Warns: Financial Explosions Often Follow Sharp Volatility
paras: 全球公債殖利率攀升，風險不僅在於借貸成本增加，更在於變動速度過快。麥格理策略師警告，過去 50 年幾乎所有備受矚目的金融危機事件，都發生在債券殖利率急劇變動後，金融機構與高負債借款人的資產負債表可能因此承受壓力。
麥格理全球策略師 Thierry Wizman 與 Gareth Berry 在近期報告中指出，長天期債券殖利率每隔幾年就會出現急升或急降，而這類劇烈波動發生後，往往伴隨金融公司或高負債借款人倒下。
麥格理列舉的案例包括 1974 年富蘭克林國民銀行倒閉、1994 年美國加州橘郡 (Orange County)破產，以及 2023 年矽谷銀行倒閉，將這些事件形容為資產負債表壓力引發的「小型危機」。
其中，資產規模約 2,000 億美元的矽谷銀行，在不到 48 小時內倒閉。聯準會升息造成該銀行持有的長天期債券投資組合價值下滑，是這場危機的重要背景。
近期債市壓力已擴及全球。美國 10 年期公債殖利率一度攀抵 2002 年以來最高水準。
根據 Yardeni Research 數據，法國、義大利、印尼、日本與南韓的公債殖利率，今年以來也都上升至少 100 個基點，即 1 個百分點。債券殖利率與價格呈反向變動，殖利率上升意味債券價格下跌。
麥格理也指出，法國近期因政府擬削減預算而爆發的街頭騷亂，與法國債市壓力之間，存在直接且相互強化的因果關係，反映財政與社會動盪可能進一步牽動金融市場。
儘管債券殖利率已回到 2008 年金融危機前的水準，強勁企業獲利與聯準會暫停升息，仍被視為支撐美股續漲的因素。不過，華爾街策略師正密切關注美國 10 年期公債殖利率是否觸及關鍵門檻。
Fundstrat 經濟策略師 Hardika Singh 近期指出，歷史數據顯示，當 10 年期公債殖利率突破 5.5%，股票估值便開始受到壓縮，投資人、企業與消費者都將需要重新計算各項投資的成本與報酬。
paras_en: Global sovereign bond yields are climbing, the risk lies not only in higher borrowing costs but also in the speed of change. Macquarie strategists warn that in almost every major financial crisis of the past 50 years, it occurred after a rapid shift in bond yields, putting pressure on the balance sheets of financial institutions and highly leveraged borrowers.

Macquarie global strategists Thierry Wizman and Gareth Berry noted in a recent report that long‑term bond yields tend to spike up or down every few years, and such extreme swings are often followed by the collapse of financial firms or highly leveraged borrowers.

Macquarie cites cases such as the 1974 collapse of Franklin National Bank, the 1994 bankruptcy of Orange County, California, and the 2023 failure of Silicon Valley Bank, describing these events as ‘small crises’ triggered by balance‑sheet stress.

Silicon Valley Bank, with assets of about $200 billion, failed in less than 48 hours. The Fed’s rate hikes caused the value of its long‑term bond portfolio to fall, providing a key backdrop to the crisis.
Bond‑market pressure has recently spread globally. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield briefly rose to its highest level since 2002.

According to Yardeni Research data, sovereign yields in France, Italy, Indonesia, Japan and South Korea have each risen by at least 100 basis points – i.e., one percentage point – so far this year. Bond yields move inversely to prices, so higher yields mean lower bond prices.

Macquarie also points out that the recent street protests in France over the government’s budget‑cut plans are directly and mutually reinforcing with pressure in the French bond market, reflecting how fiscal and social unrest can further tug at financial markets.

Although bond yields have returned to pre‑2008‑crisis levels, strong corporate earnings and the Fed’s pause on rate hikes are still seen as supporting continued gains in U.S. equities. Nevertheless, Wall Street strategists are closely watching whether the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield reaches a critical threshold.

Fundstrat economist Hardika Singh recently noted that historical data show when the 10‑year Treasury yield breaks above 5.5%, stock valuations start to compress, and investors, companies and consumers will need to recalculate the costs and returns of various investments.

items.title: 台積領先優勢還能守幾年？傳輝達2028下半年評估採英特爾Foveros封裝
items.title_en: How Many More Years Can TSMC’s Lead Advantage Last? Rumor Says Nvidia May Evaluate Using Intel’s Foveros Packaging in Late 2028
paras: 南韓GF證券分析師Jeff Pu出具最新研報指出，輝達可能在2028年下半年於部分後端環節採用英特爾Foveros先進封裝，但目前尚無任何合約或具體產品定案，屬市場推測。英特爾先進封裝組合已涵蓋EMIB、Foveros、Foveros Direct等，並對外爭取AI客戶。
但此一說法呼應《DigiTimes》今年1月爆料稱輝達未來Feynman系列GPU主體仍交台積電先進製程，配套I/O或非核心裸片可評估英特爾18A、14A，後端再由其封裝。
英特爾14A預計2028年下半年高容量量產，時程與Foveros推進吻合。
技術上，EMIB以嵌入式矽橋橫向連接芯粒，EMIB-T加矽通孔做垂直供電與訊號；Foveros更進一步把運算裸片垂直堆疊於基底，縮小封裝面積、縮短互連，有利頻寬與能效。
對輝達而言，引入英特爾封裝可分散對台積電CoWoS等產能的依賴，緩解AI加速器需求高峰下的瓶頸；對英特爾而言，即便僅拿到Feynman後端或少量非核心訂單，重點也不在即時超越先進前段製程，而是完成Foveros大規模工業驗證、切入資料中心AI供應鏈。
paras_en: South Korea’s GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu issued a new research note stating that Nvidia could adopt Intel’s advanced Foveros packaging for some back‑end stages in the second half of 2028, but there are currently no contracts or concrete product decisions – it remains market speculation. Intel’s advanced packaging portfolio already includes EMIB, Foveros, and Foveros Direct, and the company is courting AI customers.

The claim echoes a DigiTimes report from January that Nvidia’s upcoming Feynman‑series GPUs will still be fabricated on TSMC’s advanced process, while I/O or non‑core die‑shots could be evaluated on Intel’s 18A or 14A nodes, with the back‑end handled by Intel’s packaging.
Intel’s 14A is slated for high‑volume production in the second half of 2028, a timeline that aligns with the rollout of Foveros.

Technically, EMIB uses an embedded silicon bridge to connect chiplets laterally, while EMIB‑T adds silicon vias for vertical power and signal delivery; Foveros goes further by vertically stacking compute dies on a substrate, reducing package footprint and interconnect length, which benefits bandwidth and energy efficiency.

For Nvidia, adopting Intel’s packaging could diversify away from reliance on TSMC’s CoWoS capacity and ease bottlenecks during AI accelerator demand peaks; for Intel, even capturing only the Feynman back‑end or a small number of non‑core orders is less about immediately overtaking advanced front‑end processes and more about achieving large‑scale industrial validation of Foveros and entering the data‑center AI supply chain.

items.title: 期中選舉倒數 路透/益普民調：78%美國人怪川普政策推高物價
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: Reuters/Ipsos Poll Finds 78% of Americans Blame Trump Policies for Rising Prices
paras: 美國總統川普的經濟政策面臨新的民意壓力。路透／益普索最新民調顯示, 78%的美國民眾認為, 川普政府的政策至少應為生活成本上漲負起部分責任, 而且物價漲幅已超過收入成長速度。這項看法不只存在於民主黨支持者之間, 共和黨與無黨派選民也有相當比例持相同立場。隨著美國11月3日國會期中選舉逼近, 通膨、能源成本與家庭購買力已成為影響選民觀感的重要議題。
民調顯示, 57%的共和黨受訪者也認為, 生活成本上升速度已超過薪資成長, 反映川普在2024年競選期間承諾迅速壓低通膨、降低物價, 但民眾對日常開銷的感受仍與政府承諾存在落差。
在經濟施政評價方面, 約四分之一的共和黨受訪者不滿川普處理經濟的方式, 無黨派選民的比例升至63%, 民主黨受訪者則高達92%。若單獨檢視通膨問題, 68%的全體受訪者對川普政府的處理方式表示不滿, 共和黨受訪者中也有40%持相同看法。
對生活成本的感受同樣偏向負面。54%的受訪者表示, 過去一年生活成本「大幅」上升, 其中包括40%的共和黨受訪者; 另有30%認為成本只是小幅增加, 10%認為生活成本沒有變化。整體而言, 78%的受訪者認為白宮應對物價上漲負起部分責任, 其中共和黨支持者占64%, 無黨派選民占76%。多數受訪者也將關稅視為推高物價的重要因素之一。
能源價格是家庭負擔加重的另一項關鍵因素。美國汽油平均價格在10月8日升至每加侖4.36美元, 高於一年前的3.11美元; 柴油價格則達每加侖6.28美元, 近期漲勢尤其明顯。中東戰事推升全球能源成本, 加上川普政府對進口商品加徵關稅, 使能源與商品價格同時成為通膨壓力來源。
物價壓力也延伸至住房市場。美國30年期房貸利率已升至7.5%, 約為6年前購屋者習慣水準的兩倍。汽油、食品、機票及住房融資成本上升, 讓民眾即使收入有所增加, 仍可能感到購買力改善有限。
面對開銷攀升, 部分美國家庭開始減少非必要支出。民調顯示, 63%的受訪者表示, 自己外出用餐的頻率已降低; 另有56%減少娛樂活動或串流服務支出。表示減少開車或已開始延遲支付帳單的受訪者比例則相對較低, 顯示目前消費調整主要集中在餐飲與娛樂等項目。
不過, 調查也顯示, 部分川普政策主張仍獲得支持。45%的受訪者認為, 未經授權移民是物價上漲的根源之一。川普政府曾主張, 非法移民增加住房等資源需求, 可能推升部分生活成本。這項結果反映, 儘管民眾對經濟施政與通膨處理存在不滿, 移民政策仍是部分選民評估物價問題時的重要因素。
白宮發言人泰勒・羅傑斯則為政府經濟政策辯護, 表示川普已終結前總統拜登任內的通膨危機, 並透過減稅、促進經濟成長及降低處方藥價格, 為美國家庭帶來實際成果。拜登任內的通膨曾升至40年高點, 也是川普在2024年總統大選勝出的重要背景之一。
然而, 通膨率從疫情期間的高點回落, 並不代表物價已恢復至過去水準。汽油、牛絞肉及機票等日常商品與服務價格仍處於較高水位, 而利率上升也增加家庭貸款負擔。美國整體時薪雖仍有成長, 但增幅大致與消費者物價指數接近, 意味著相當一部分薪資增加被更高的生活成本抵銷。
經濟與消費者信心調查也反映類似情緒。美國經濟諮商局與紐約聯邦準備銀行的相關調查, 均呈現消費者對經濟前景偏向悲觀的情況。通膨持續、能源成本上升與家庭購買力受壓, 也使川普的經濟支持度面臨挑戰。
這項路透／益普索民調採全美線上調查方式進行, 為期6天, 於周一結束, 共訪問4,506名美國成年人。全體受訪者的抽樣誤差約為2個百分點; 共和黨、民主黨及無黨派選民等分組的抽樣誤差約為3個百分點。
隨著期中選舉進入倒數階段, 生活成本與通膨將持續考驗執政團隊的經濟論述。民調顯示, 即使部分共和黨選民仍支持川普的移民政策, 對物價上漲的切身感受已跨越黨派界線。接下來, 能源價格走勢、關稅對商品成本的影響, 以及薪資能否追上生活開銷, 都將是美國選民評估政府經濟表現的重要因素。
paras_en: U.S. President Trump’s economic policies are facing new public pressure. A latest Reuters/Ipsos poll shows that 78% of Americans believe the Trump administration’s policies should bear at least some responsibility for the rise in the cost of living, and that price increases have outpaced income growth. This view is not limited to Democratic supporters; a sizable share of Republican and independent voters share the same stance. With the November 3 midterm elections approaching, inflation, energy costs and household purchasing power have become key issues shaping voter sentiment.

The poll indicates that 57% of Republican respondents also think the pace of rising living costs has outstripped wage growth, reflecting a gap between Trump’s 2024 campaign promise to quickly curb inflation and lower prices and voters’ everyday experience of expenses.

Regarding economic performance, about one‑quarter of Republican respondents are dissatisfied with Trump’s handling of the economy, while dissatisfaction among independents rises to 63% and reaches 92% among Democratic respondents. Looking solely at inflation, 68% of all respondents express disapproval of the Trump administration’s approach, and 40% of Republican respondents share that view.

Feelings about the cost of living are similarly negative. Fifty‑four percent say living costs have risen "significantly" over the past year, including 40% of Republican respondents; another 30% say costs have risen only modestly, and 10% say there has been no change. Overall, 78% think the White House should bear some responsibility for price hikes, with 64% of Republican supporters and 76% of independents agreeing. Most respondents also cite tariffs as a major factor driving up prices.

Energy prices are another key burden for households. U.S. gasoline averaged $4.36 per gallon on Oct. 8, up from $3.11 a year earlier; diesel hit $6.28 per gallon, with a sharp recent surge. Conflict in the Middle East has pushed global energy costs higher, and Trump’s tariffs on imported goods have added to inflationary pressure from both energy and consumer goods.

Price pressure is also spilling into the housing market. The 30‑year mortgage rate has climbed to 7.5%, roughly double the level homebuyers were accustomed to six years ago. Rising gasoline, food, airline fares and housing‑finance costs mean that even with higher incomes, many feel their purchasing power has improved only modestly.

Facing higher expenses, some U.S. families are cutting non‑essential spending. The poll shows 63% have reduced how often they dine out, and 56% have cut back on entertainment or streaming services. Fewer respondents report driving less or delaying bill payments, indicating that current consumption adjustments are focused mainly on food‑service and entertainment categories.

Nevertheless, the survey also finds that certain Trump policy positions retain support. Forty‑five percent say unauthorized immigration is one cause of rising prices. The Trump administration has argued that illegal immigration increases demand for housing and other resources, potentially pushing up some living costs. This result shows that despite dissatisfaction with economic policy and inflation handling, immigration remains an important factor for some voters when assessing price issues.

White House spokesperson Taylor Rogers defended the administration’s economic agenda, claiming Trump ended the inflation surge that began under President Biden and delivered tangible benefits to American families through tax cuts, growth‑stimulating measures and lower prescription‑drug prices. Inflation under Biden had reached a 40‑year high, a backdrop that Trump is using to bolster his 2024 presidential bid.

However, the decline in inflation from its pandemic peak does not mean prices have returned to pre‑pandemic levels. Gasoline, ground‑beef and airline tickets remain elevated, and higher interest rates increase household loan burdens. While overall hourly wages are still rising, the gains roughly match the consumer‑price index, meaning much of the wage increase is offset by higher living costs.

Economic and consumer‑confidence surveys echo the same sentiment. Surveys from the U.S. Economic Advisory Board and the New York Federal Reserve both show consumers leaning pessimistic about the economic outlook. Ongoing inflation, rising energy costs and squeezed household purchasing power are also challenging Trump’s support on economic issues.

The Reuters/Ipsos poll was conducted online nationwide over six days, ending on Monday, with 4,506 U.S. adults surveyed. The overall margin of error is about two percentage points; the margin for Republican, Democratic and independent sub‑samples is roughly three points.

As the midterm race enters its final stretch, living‑cost and inflation pressures will continue to test the governing team’s economic narrative. The poll shows that even as some Republican voters still back Trump’s immigration stance, the personal impact of price rises crosses party lines. Going forward, energy‑price trends, tariff effects on commodity costs and whether wages can keep pace with expenses will be key factors voters use to evaluate the government’s economic performance.

items.title: 川普對伊朗動武再改口！期中選舉前「可能」發動攻擊？
items.title_en: Trump Reverses Stance on Military Action Against Iran! May Launch Attack Before Midterm Elections?
paras: 美國總統川普對伊朗的軍事行動時程再現矛盾訊號。他週四（8日）才表示，美國不會在國會期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱雙方談判進展順利，但週五（9日）被問及為何不立即採取行動時，卻改口表示「可能會」，令美國對伊政策走向更加難以預測，也加深市場對中東局勢的疑慮。
川普週五在白宮接受媒體提問時，被問到美國為何不立即對伊朗採取行動，以及是否可能在期中選舉前發動攻擊。他回應，美國「可能會」採取行動，與前一天的說法形成明顯反差。
川普週四在社群平台Truth Social發文表示，美國與伊朗正進行「富有成效」的磋商，因此美方不會在國會期中選舉前對伊朗發動攻擊。
不過，他同時強調，伊朗的經濟與軍事狀況都「極度糟糕」，並重申伊朗不會擁有核武器。
在川普發布上述聲明前，美國媒體週三（7日）晚間曾報導，川普正考慮在期中選舉前對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，相關行動也可能安排在10月底以色列議會選舉前。
如今，川普再度釋出不同訊號，使美國是否升高對伊軍事行動仍充滿不確定性。
此外，川普週五也對葉門胡塞武裝襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯機場一事表達不滿，稱這不是好事，並表示自己對此感到不高興。
在軍事行動時程仍不明朗之際，美國也持續加大對伊朗的經濟施壓。
根據陸媒《央視》新聞， 美國財政部8日宣布新一輪對伊制裁，將17艘運輸伊朗原油、石油產品及石化產品的船隻列入制裁名單。
美國財政部官員指出，美方估計，目前仍有約2,000萬桶伊朗原油滯留在船上，且不包括在美國封鎖伊朗港口的範圍內。官員並表示，受到美國封鎖與制裁影響，伊朗已停止原油船隻的裝載及卸載作業。
美國對伊朗的封鎖與制裁，也使全球重要能源運輸通道荷姆茲海峽的石油運輸面臨壓力。
英國《金融時報》報導，初步數據顯示，本週二通過荷姆茲海峽的原油僅約400萬桶，遠低於9月下旬每日平均約1,500萬桶的水準。
美國能源資訊署（EIA）數據顯示，在美國與以色列於今年2月28日聯手對伊朗發動軍事行動前，2025年第四季荷姆茲海峽每日平均石油流量約為2,160萬桶，相當於全球石油消費量的五分之一。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump sent mixed signals again about the timing of a military strike on Iran. On Thursday (the 8th) he said the United States would not attack Iran before the congressional midterm elections, claiming that negotiations were progressing smoothly, but on Friday (the 9th) he changed his answer when asked why the U.S. was not acting immediately, saying an attack "might" happen, making America’s policy toward Iran even harder to predict and deepening market concerns about the Middle East.

On Friday, Trump was questioned by the press at the White House about why the United States was not taking immediate action against Iran and whether an attack could occur before the midterms. He replied that the United States "might" take action, a stark contrast to his statement the day before.

On Thursday, Trump posted on his Truth Social platform that the United States and Iran were engaged in "productive" talks, and therefore the U.S. would not launch an attack on Iran before the congressional midterm elections.
He also stressed that Iran’s economic and military situation is "extremely dire" and reiterated that Iran will not acquire nuclear weapons.

Before Trump issued the above statements, U.S. media reported on Wednesday night (the 7th) that Trump was considering a new round of attacks on Iran before the midterms, with possible operations slated for before Israel’s parliamentary election at the end of October.
Now Trump has again sent a different signal, leaving the likelihood of an escalated U.S. military action against Iran uncertain.
In addition, on Friday Trump expressed displeasure over the Houthi attack on a Saudi Arabian airport, calling it "not a good thing" and saying he was unhappy about it.
While the timeline for any military action remains unclear, the United States continues to increase economic pressure on Iran.

According to China’s state broadcaster CCTV, the U.S. Treasury Department announced on the 8th a new round of sanctions on Iran, adding 17 vessels that transport Iranian crude oil, petroleum products and petrochemicals to the sanctions list.

U.S. Treasury officials estimated that about 20 million barrels of Iranian crude remain on board ships, not covered by the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports. They said the blockade and sanctions have forced Iran to halt loading and unloading operations for its crude‑carrying vessels.
The U.S. blockade and sanctions on Iran have also put pressure on the vital global energy corridor, the Strait of Hormuz, affecting oil shipments.

The Financial Times reported that preliminary data show only about 4 million barrels of crude passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, far below the roughly 15 million barrels per day average recorded in late September.

EIA data indicate that before the joint U.S.–Israeli military action against Iran on February 28 this year, the average daily oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz in Q4 2025 was about 21.6 million barrels, roughly one‑fifth of global oil consumption.

items.title: 全球需求降溫了？蘋果傳砍iPhone 18 Pro零組件訂單15%
items.title_en: Is Global Demand Cooling? Apple Rumored to Cut iPhone 18 Pro Component Orders by 15%
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)據傳要求多家供應商降低兩款近期上市的iPhone機型零組件產量，消息傳出後，蘋果股價周五下跌。
根據《日經亞洲》引述多名知情人士報導，蘋果上月初對iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max的出貨安排轉趨保守。
其中兩名消息人士透露，由於需求不如預期，蘋果10月的零組件訂單較最初提出的數量減少約15%。
蘋果股價周五下跌1.1%，收於每股336.64美元。

蘋果於9月9日發表iPhone 18 Pro，以及尺寸較大的iPhone 18 Pro Max。新機提供黑色、銀色、酒紅色與冰川色等選擇。較小Pro機型續航力最長可達24小時，較大的Pro Max最長可達30小時。執行長特納斯(John Ternus)表示，公司在新產品的電池、智慧功能、相機與效能方面都取得了「重大進展」。iPhone 18 Pro起售價為1,199美元，Pro Max則從1,299美元起。
一名向《日經亞洲》透露消息的高階主管表示，對於蘋果下調這兩款新上市高階手機的零組件訂單，「我們還不知道接下來情況會如何發展」。目前尚不清楚蘋果是否也會調整11月的訂單需求。報導指出，本月出貨量的調整將影響部分供應商，但並非所有供應商都會受到波及。
新iPhone上市後最初幾周於中國市場的銷售表現似乎相當強勁，但隨著記憶體晶片價格飆升，全球需求看來相對疲弱。
目前尚不清楚蘋果與哪些特定供應商接洽，不過塔塔電子(Tata Electronics)是iPhone 18 Pro的重要製造商。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)與高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)則為蘋果供應晶片。台積電ADR股價周五下跌1%，高通則小幅走低。
摩根士丹利分析師團隊由Erik Woodring領軍，他們在10月初發布的報告中指出，兩款新機上市後，尚未觀察到供應鏈出現大幅調整。分析師寫道，「蘋果的產品規劃仍是十多年來最令人期待的之一。」他們並補充，該行對蘋果的獲利展望大致維持不變。
摩根士丹利維持對蘋果2027會計年度每股盈餘約10美元、2028會計年度接近11美元的預估。由於市場對蘋果服務部門長期變現能力仍存疑慮，該行將目標價從360美元小幅下調至355美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Apple (AAPL-US) is said to have asked several suppliers to reduce component production for two recently launched iPhone models, and the news sent Apple’s stock down on Friday.
According to Nikkei Asia, citing multiple insiders, Apple’s shipment plans for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max became more conservative at the beginning of last month.
Two sources said that, because demand fell short of expectations, Apple’s component orders for October were about 15% lower than the quantities originally requested.
Apple’s shares fell 1.1% on Friday, closing at $336.64 per share.

Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and the larger iPhone 18 Pro Max on September 9. The new phones are offered in black, silver, burgundy and glacier colors. The smaller Pro model can last up to 24 hours on a single charge, while the larger Pro Max can reach 30 hours. CEO John Ternus said the company made “significant advances” in battery, smart features, camera and performance. The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and the Pro Max starts at $1,299.

A senior executive who spoke to Nikkei Asia said Apple’s reduction of component orders for the two newly launched high‑end phones leaves “uncertainty about how the situation will develop.” It is not yet clear whether Apple will also adjust its November order demand. The report noted that the shipment adjustments this month will affect some suppliers but not all.
In the first few weeks after launch, the new iPhones sold quite strongly in China, but as memory‑chip prices have surged, global demand now appears relatively weak.

It is not known which specific suppliers Apple is negotiating with, but Tata Electronics is a key manufacturer for the iPhone 18 Pro. TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) supply chips to Apple. TSMC’s ADR fell 1% on Friday, while Qualcomm slipped slightly.

Morgan Stanley’s analyst team led by Erik Woodring noted in a report released in early October that, after the two new models went live, they had not yet observed major adjustments in the supply chain. The analysts wrote, “Apple’s product planning remains one of the most anticipated in over a decade,” and added that the firm’s earnings outlook for Apple remains largely unchanged.

Morgan Stanley maintains its estimate of roughly $10 earnings per share for Apple’s fiscal 2027 and close to $11 for fiscal 2028. Because the market still questions the long‑term monetization of Apple’s services segment, the bank trimmed its target price slightly from $360 to $355.

items.title: 台積領先優勢還能守幾年？傳輝達2028下半年評估採英特爾Foveros封裝
items.title_en: How Many More Years Can TSMC’s Lead Advantage Last? Rumor Says Nvidia May Evaluate Using Intel’s Foveros Packaging in Late 2028
paras: 南韓GF證券分析師Jeff Pu出具最新研報指出，輝達可能在2028年下半年於部分後端環節採用英特爾Foveros先進封裝，但目前尚無任何合約或具體產品定案，屬市場推測。英特爾先進封裝組合已涵蓋EMIB、Foveros、Foveros Direct等，並對外爭取AI客戶。
但此一說法呼應《DigiTimes》今年1月爆料稱輝達未來Feynman系列GPU主體仍交台積電先進製程，配套I/O或非核心裸片可評估英特爾18A、14A，後端再由其封裝。
英特爾14A預計2028年下半年高容量量產，時程與Foveros推進吻合。
技術上，EMIB以嵌入式矽橋橫向連接芯粒，EMIB-T加矽通孔做垂直供電與訊號；Foveros更進一步把運算裸片垂直堆疊於基底，縮小封裝面積、縮短互連，有利頻寬與能效。
對輝達而言，引入英特爾封裝可分散對台積電CoWoS等產能的依賴，緩解AI加速器需求高峰下的瓶頸；對英特爾而言，即便僅拿到Feynman後端或少量非核心訂單，重點也不在即時超越先進前段製程，而是完成Foveros大規模工業驗證、切入資料中心AI供應鏈。
paras_en: South Korea’s GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu issued a new research note stating that Nvidia could adopt Intel’s advanced Foveros packaging for some back‑end stages in the second half of 2028, but there are currently no contracts or concrete product decisions – it remains market speculation. Intel’s advanced packaging portfolio already includes EMIB, Foveros, and Foveros Direct, and the company is courting AI customers.

The claim echoes a DigiTimes report from January that Nvidia’s upcoming Feynman‑series GPUs will still be fabricated on TSMC’s advanced process, while I/O or non‑core die‑shots could be evaluated on Intel’s 18A or 14A nodes, with the back‑end handled by Intel’s packaging.
Intel’s 14A is slated for high‑volume production in the second half of 2028, a timeline that aligns with the rollout of Foveros.

Technically, EMIB uses an embedded silicon bridge to connect chiplets laterally, while EMIB‑T adds silicon vias for vertical power and signal delivery; Foveros goes further by vertically stacking compute dies on a substrate, reducing package footprint and interconnect length, which benefits bandwidth and energy efficiency.

For Nvidia, adopting Intel’s packaging could diversify away from reliance on TSMC’s CoWoS capacity and ease bottlenecks during AI accelerator demand peaks; for Intel, even capturing only the Feynman back‑end or a small number of non‑core orders is less about immediately overtaking advanced front‑end processes and more about achieving large‑scale industrial validation of Foveros and entering the data‑center AI supply chain.

items.title: 居家產業走出二年來低谷 家具、家電Q4買氣續旺
items.title_en: Home Industry Emerges from Two-Year Low as Furniture and Appliances See Strong Q4 Demand
paras: 隨著預售屋交屋潮湧現，國內連鎖家具龍頭詩肯(6195-TW)最新指出，觀察到近期家具需求大增，帶動居家產業快速復甦，預料第四季傳統消費旺季將持續穩健成長。
詩肯前三季合併營收18.61億元，年增15.67%，詩肯指出，隨著預售案大量進入交屋期，自住族群與首購族的家具採購需求已開始回溫，是今年居家產業走出過去兩年的低谷的主因。
而在家庭結構改變下，台灣住宅普遍朝向小宅發展，消費者更偏好高收納、多功能、體積精簡且美型設計的家具，也使詩肯在家具市場更具競爭力。
詩肯認為，第四季進入傳統居家消費旺季，換屋、裝修及年末居家整理需求增加將帶動汰舊換新潮，家具市場消費動能可望維持到農曆年前。
截至9月底，詩肯全台門市為84店，仍將視市場需求與商圈條件持續尋找展店機會，同時強化既有店的業務動能。
集雅社則指出，因今年是經濟部住宅家電汰舊換新節能補助的最後一年，一級能效冷氣、冰箱每台可申請3000元補助，搭配貨物稅退稅最高2000元，合計最高可省5000元，隨著周年慶進入旺季，高階家電換機需求升溫。
paras_en: As the wave of pre‑sale home handovers rolls in, domestic furniture chain leader Shiken (6195‑TW) noted a recent surge in furniture demand, driving a rapid recovery in the home sector and forecasting steady growth through the traditional fourth‑quarter consumption peak.

Shiken reported combined revenue of NT$1.861 billion for the first three quarters, up 15.67% year‑on‑year, and said that as many pre‑sale projects enter the handover phase, furniture purchases by owner‑occupiers and first‑time buyers have begun to rebound, which is the main reason the home industry is emerging from a two‑year trough this year.

With household structures shifting, Taiwanese residences are increasingly compact, leading consumers to favor furniture that offers high storage, multifunctionality, slim dimensions and stylish design, giving Shiken a competitive edge in the market.

Shiken believes that the fourth quarter marks the traditional home‑consumption peak, with increased demand for moving, renovation and year‑end home organization spurring a cycle of replacing old items, and expects the furniture market’s consumer momentum to continue through the Lunar New Year.

As of the end of September, Shiken operated 84 stores nationwide and will continue to seek expansion opportunities based on market demand and location conditions while strengthening the performance of existing outlets.

Jiya Society pointed out that this year is the final year for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ subsidy program for replacing residential appliances with energy‑efficient models; first‑class efficient air conditioners and refrigerators qualify for a NT$3,000 subsidy per unit, plus up to NT$2,000 in goods‑tax rebates, for a total possible saving of NT$5,000, and with the anniversary sales season in full swing, demand for high‑end appliance upgrades is heating up.

items.title: 全球低軌衛星部署加速 啓碁、耀登卡位地面設備與天線長線看俏
items.title_en: Global Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite Deployment Accelerates; Qisda and Yao‑Den Poised for Ground Equipment and Antenna Demand Surge
paras: 全球低軌衛星市場迎來新一波爆發期，隨著SpaceX星鏈計畫邁向新一代V3規模部署以及藍色起源等科技巨擘擴大太空布局，在地面終端設備與射頻天線領域耕耘已久的網通大廠啓碁(6285-TW)與射頻廠耀登(3138-TW)長線營運直接受惠。
根據研調機構TrendForce預估，在V3衛星部署、星艦降低發射成本以及6G非地面網路應用逐步成形帶動下，全球衛星火箭發射市場規模將由2026年的293億美元增至2028年的404億美元，兩年成長近40%，且受惠範圍正由零組件向模組與系統整合全面擴大。
在產業產值結構中，地面裝置製造占比高達54.58%，屬於產值最大且台廠最具競爭優勢的領域，而隨著Starlink訂閱用戶數持續攀升至1200萬戶，加上亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下藍色起源正規劃部署逾5萬顆衛星的軌道資料中心與TeraWave企業級衛星通訊，龐大的地面終端需求正加速釋出。
為深耕技術並降低射頻前端成本，啓碁日前更與工研院資通所展開合作，共同推動國產Ka頻段陣列天線模組量產，藉由採用台灣首款自主開發的波束成型晶片，加速地面接收端、無人機、車載等高移動性終端場域的商用化進程。
耀登則鎖定6G非地面網路與低軌衛星地面設備商機，除了取得國家太空中心Ka頻段地面接收站專案並與低軌及中高軌衛星客戶接洽外，在量測認證服務上也已將驗證能力延伸至衛星地面收發設備，提供客戶一站式整合服務。
在量測設備業務方面，耀登已導入加拿大與丹麥兩家關鍵衛星通訊模擬與天線測試設備代理，海外產能方面，兩家業者亦積極推進非紅供應鏈布局以去化長線訂單，啓碁擴建越南與墨西哥產能，並規劃2026年越南產能占比過半，耀登的越南新廠也預定第三季投產，未來產線更具備擴充至18條的潛力。
paras_en: The global low‑Earth‑orbit (LEO) satellite market is entering a new wave of explosive growth. With SpaceX’s Starlink moving to a next‑generation V3 large‑scale deployment and tech giants such as Blue Origin expanding their space footprint, network‑equipment giants that have long cultivated the ground‑terminal and RF‑antenna sectors—Qisda (6285‑TW) and RF firm Yao‑Den (3138‑TW)—are set to benefit directly from long‑term operations.

According to research firm TrendForce, the worldwide satellite‑rocket launch market is projected to expand from $29.3 billion in 2026 to $40.4 billion in 2028—a near‑40% increase over two years—driven by V3 satellite deployments, reduced launch costs from Starship, and the gradual emergence of 6G non‑terrestrial network applications. The beneficiary scope is widening from components to full‑module and system integration.

Within the industry value chain, ground‑device manufacturing accounts for a hefty 54.58% of total output, making it the largest segment and the one where Taiwanese firms hold the strongest competitive edge. As Starlink’s subscriber base climbs to 12 million and Amazon’s Blue Origin plans an orbital data‑center and TeraWave enterprise‑grade satellite communications network backed by more than 50,000 satellites, massive demand for ground terminals is being released at speed.

To deepen its technology and cut RF front‑end costs, Qisda recently partnered with the Institute for Information Industry’s Communications Research Institute to push mass production of a domestically‑made Ka‑band array‑antenna module. The effort leverages Taiwan’s first home‑grown beam‑forming chip to accelerate commercialization of high‑mobility terminals such as ground receivers, drones and vehicle‑mounted units.

Yao‑Den is targeting the 6G non‑terrestrial network and LEO ground‑equipment market. In addition to securing a Ka‑band ground‑station project from the National Space Center and engaging with LEO and medium‑high‑orbit satellite customers, the company has extended its measurement‑certification capabilities to satellite ground‑transceiver equipment, offering customers a one‑stop integrated service.

In its measurement‑equipment business, Yao‑Den has incorporated two key satellite‑communication simulation and antenna‑testing equipment agents from Canada and Denmark. Regarding overseas capacity, both partners are actively advancing non‑red‑supply‑chain layouts to absorb long‑term orders. Qisda is expanding capacity in Vietnam and Mexico, aiming for Vietnam to account for over half of its output by 2026, while Yao‑Den’s new Vietnam plant is slated to start production in Q3, with the line designed for future expansion to up to 18 lines.

items.title: 每2人就有1個E人！貝萊德調查：台灣ETF滲透率53%穩居亞太第一
items.title_en: One in Two People Own an ETF! BlackRock Survey Shows Taiwan’s ETF Penetration at 53%, Highest in Asia‑Pacific
paras: 全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares發布最新《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，高居亞太五大市場之冠。相較於香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%、澳洲的16%及日本的3%，台灣市場展現極高的普及度與成熟度。在產品偏好上，台灣投資人除了擁抱股票型（55%）與高股息型（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好度更達40%，顯著超越澳洲與香港，成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。貝萊德投信表示，ETF在台灣已從單純投資工具轉化為全民理財基礎，未來成長動能將來自配置觀念的持續進化。
當ETF從單純的投資工具演變為全民理財語言，台灣正以驚人的普及速度站上亞太市場的領先地位。全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares最新發布《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露亞太五大市場的最新投資面貌。調查顯示，台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，不僅榮登亞太五大市場龍頭，普及率更遠超日本的3%近18倍，展現顯著的區域成熟度落差。
針對本次宏觀調查結果，貝萊德投信董事總經理陳正芳表示，這項橫跨台灣、澳洲、日本、新加坡及香港的調查顯示，亞太各地的ETF發展步調存在巨大懸殊。台灣成年人在ETF持有滲透率上拔得頭籌（53%），大幅領先第二名香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%與澳洲的16%，而日本市場則以3%居末，凸顯台灣在ETF市場的普及程度已成熟領跑全亞太。
在產品偏好層面，陳正芳分析，亞太區投資人對ETF展現出「核心配置共通、周邊需求在地化」的分歧特色。雖然股票型與收益型ETF是亞太各市場共同的核心投資基石，但走出核心資產之外，各市場的投資偏好則展現出鮮明的在地色彩。
陳正芳進一步說明，台灣投資人除了高度青睞股票型（55%）與高股息／收益型ETF（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好更在亞太市場中異軍突起，持有比例高達40%。這一數據顯著超越澳洲的25%與香港的24%，讓台灣一舉成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。
對比亞太其他地區，各國投資人的偏好呈現多元發展。澳洲投資人高度偏好數位資產（加密貨幣）ETF，比例高達40%，僅次於股票型的58%；香港投資人除了以股票型（75%）為大宗外，偏好則廣泛分散於債券型（47%）、商品型（39%）與貨幣型ETF（37%）。
陳正芳強調，調查結果充分反映台灣在ETF普及率與產品接受度上均已躍居亞太領頭羊，投資人不僅將ETF視為核心資產配置工具，對主動型等新型態ETF也展現出成熟且開放的配置意願。ETF在台灣已從單純的投資工具，逐步發展為大眾理財與長期資產配置的重要基礎，未來市場成長動能將不僅來自投資人數增加，更來自投資需求的持續進化與配置觀念的成熟。
paras_en: BlackRock’s iShares, the world’s largest ETF brand, released its latest “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, revealing that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, the highest penetration among the five major Asia‑Pacific markets. Compared with Hong Kong’s 31%, Singapore’s 18.7%, Australia’s 16% and Japan’s 3%, Taiwan demonstrates a very high level of adoption and market maturity. In terms of product preference, Taiwanese investors not only embrace equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend (52%) ETFs, but also show a 40% preference for “active ETFs,” markedly surpassing Australia and Hong Kong and making Taiwan the strongest demand market for active products in the region. BlackRock Investment Management says ETFs in Taiwan have shifted from a simple investment tool to a foundation of personal finance for the whole population, with future growth driven by the continued evolution of allocation concepts.

As ETFs evolve from a pure investment tool into a language of personal finance for the masses, Taiwan is rapidly taking the lead in the Asia‑Pacific market. BlackRock’s iShares has just published its “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, unveiling the latest investment landscape across the five largest markets in the region. The survey shows that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, not only topping the Asia‑Pacific list but also exceeding Japan’s 3% by nearly eighteen‑fold, highlighting a striking regional maturity gap.

Commenting on the macro‑survey results, Chen Zheng‑fang, Managing Director of BlackRock Investment Management, said the cross‑country study covering Taiwan, Australia, Japan, Singapore and Hong Kong shows a huge disparity in ETF development across Asia‑Pacific. Taiwanese adults lead with a 53% ETF‑holding penetration, far ahead of second‑place Hong Kong at 31%, Singapore at 18.7% and Australia at 16%, while Japan trails at 3%, underscoring Taiwan’s mature and leading position in the regional ETF market.

On product preference, Chen explained that investors across Asia‑Pacific exhibit a “core allocation commonality with localized peripheral demand.” While equity‑type and income‑type ETFs form the core investment foundation in all markets, preferences beyond these core assets display distinct local characteristics.

Chen added that Taiwanese investors not only strongly favor equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend/income ETFs (52%), but also stand out in the region for their preference for “active ETFs,” with a holding rate of 40%. This figure far exceeds Australia’s 25% and Hong Kong’s 24%, making Taiwan the market with the most vigorous demand for active products in Asia‑Pacific.

Compared with other Asia‑Pacific regions, investors’ preferences are diverse. Australian investors show a high appetite for digital‑asset (cryptocurrency) ETFs, at 40%, second only to equity‑type ETFs at 58%. Hong Kong investors, besides a dominant 75% preference for equity‑type ETFs, spread their interest across bond ETFs (47%), commodity ETFs (39%) and currency ETFs (37%).

Chen emphasized that the survey results clearly show Taiwan has become the Asia‑Pacific leader in both ETF penetration and product acceptance. Investors view ETFs not only as core asset‑allocation tools but also demonstrate a mature and open willingness to allocate to newer formats such as active ETFs. In Taiwan, ETFs have progressed from a simple investment instrument to a fundamental component of mass‑market financial planning and long‑term asset allocation, with future market growth driven not only by a larger investor base but also by the ongoing evolution of investment demand and sophisticated allocation mindsets.

items.title: 嘉威9月營收再現年成長達44% 前9月營收下滑幅度進一步收歛
items.title_en: Jiawei September Revenue Shows 44% Year‑over‑Year Growth as Nine‑Month Decline Further Narrows
paras: 嘉威生活(3557-TW)迎接旺季來臨前的需求再進一步升溫，嘉威9月營收達2.98億元，月增14.02%，年增44.56%；累計2026年前9月營收31.65億元，年減幅由前8月的8.85%進一步收斂至5.57%，營運回升趨勢更加明確；同時，嘉威生活第四季將迎接歐美的採購需求超級旺季。
嘉威生活的累計營收下滑幅度收歛，主要在第三季營收達7.7億元，年增幅21.18%；回升趨勢明確。 展望第四季，嘉威生活隨著美國零售市場正式進入Holiday傳統消費旺季，各主要客戶的節慶商品及Everyday商品持續出貨，公司預期第四季拉貨動能可望延續。
而嘉威生活前三季累計營收年減幅已由前8月的8.85%快速收斂至5.57%，加上FDG及Prepara持續貢獻，嘉威預期第四季可望進一步縮小與去年同期的累計營收差距，持續改善全年營運表現。
嘉威主管指出，雖然9月美國客戶已提前啟動第四季旺季拉貨模式，各主要零售通路的Holiday節慶商品全面進入出貨期，加上長期穩定的Everyday常態性商品訂單，兩大產品線合計已占公司約一半出貨量，成為9月營收大幅成長的重要動能，也反映美國市場拉貨力道持續升溫。
除大型零售通路外，嘉威長期深耕Pottery Barn、Crate & Barrel及Williams-Sonoma等中高階居家生活客戶，相關高附加價值產品維持穩定出貨，持續支持嘉威的獲利品質，形成大型零售客戶帶動營收規模、中高階客戶兼顧獲利的多元客戶組合。
海外布局方面，嘉威美國子公司FDG 9月持續貢獻營收，出貨櫃量占中國整體出貨櫃量逾10%；旗下廚具品牌Prepara則持續開發新品，加速全球銷售及通路布局，目前產品已銷往美國、歐洲、日本及韓國。公司並在美國及歐洲當地設立倉庫，透過就近供應優勢提升出貨效率，顯示除嘉威本體外，美國子公司及品牌業務也逐步挹注集團營運表現。
嘉威生活2026年上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
paras_en: Jiawei Living (3557‑TW) saw demand heat up ahead of the peak season, with September revenue reaching NT$298 million, up 14.02% month‑over‑month and 44.56% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months of 2026 was NT$3.165 billion, with the year‑over‑year decline narrowing from an 8.85% drop in the first eight months to 5.57%, indicating a clearer operational recovery. The company also expects a super‑strong procurement season in Europe and the United States in Q4.

The contraction in cumulative revenue was driven by a strong third‑quarter performance of NT$770 million, a 21.18% year‑over‑year increase, underscoring the rebound trend. Looking ahead to Q4, Jiawei Living anticipates continued momentum as the U.S. retail market enters the traditional holiday shopping season, with major customers shipping festive and everyday items, which should sustain the pull‑forward effect.

The year‑over‑year decline in cumulative revenue for the first three quarters has quickly narrowed from 8.85% after eight months to 5.57% after nine months. Combined with ongoing contributions from FDG and the Prepara brand, Jiawei expects the gap with the same period last year to shrink further in Q4, further improving full‑year performance.

Management noted that, although U.S. customers began pulling forward fourth‑quarter inventory in September, holiday merchandise across major retail channels entered the shipping phase, and stable everyday product orders persisted. The two product lines now account for roughly half of the company's shipments, driving the strong September revenue growth and reflecting continued acceleration of pull‑forward activity in the U.S. market.

Beyond large retail chains, Jiawei has long cultivated mid‑to‑high‑end home‑lifestyle customers such as Pottery Barn, Crate & Barrel and Williams‑Sonoma. High‑margin products for these accounts remain steady, supporting profit quality and creating a diversified customer mix that balances scale from big retailers with profitability from premium clients.

On the overseas front, Jiawei’s U.S. subsidiary FDG continued to contribute in September, with its container shipments representing more than 10% of the group's total containers shipped from China. Its kitchenware brand Prepara kept launching new products, accelerating global sales and channel expansion, with offerings now in the United States, Europe, Japan and South Korea. The company has also set up warehouses in the U.S. and Europe to improve delivery efficiency, showing that the U.S. subsidiary and brand businesses are increasingly bolstering the group’s overall performance.

Jiawei Living posted first‑half‑2026 revenue of NT$2.395 billion, an 11.8% year‑over‑year decline, mainly due to weaker first‑quarter sales. However, as operations recovered in the second quarter, the half‑year gross margin remained at 35.52%, up 0.27 percentage points from a year earlier. Net profit after tax was NT$57.04 million, or NT$0.68 per share.

items.title_en: Sewing‑Machine Shipping Peak Season! Shenxing’s September Revenue Sets a New Monthly High for 2026, Full‑Year Operational Growth Expected
paras: 伸興(1558-TW)公告2026年9月合併營收達 9.68 億元，月增8.81%，年增29.19%，創今年單月營收新高；2026年第三季合併營收達27.95億元，季增21.95%，年增24.31%；累計前9月合併營收70.13億元，年增8.35%。受惠於主要客戶拉貨動能增溫與產業旺季效益，良好的訂單成長基礎，有助於今年整體營運保持良好的正向成長動能。
伸興表示，每年第二至第三季是家用縫紉機產業的傳統出貨旺季，主要受惠於歐美市場聖誕節、感恩節等節慶購物季前夕的通路補貨需求。隨著終端零售通路庫存健康度持續回升，各大國際縫紉機品牌客戶積極備貨，推升公司9月家用縫紉機出貨量大幅提升。
除傳統季節性旺季效益發酵外，近年來全球手作DIY文化、客製化服飾與個人化手作紡織品的流行趨勢熱度不減，進一步帶動中高階家用縫紉機與多功能電縫機的穩定需求。伸興憑藉優異的研發製造能力，成功協助客戶推出具備智慧化與便利操作功能的機種，有效掌握市場趨勢，進一步挹注整體營運成長動能，助力整體訂單保持良好的能見度。
面對全球供應鏈重組與市場快速變化的挑戰，伸興持續精進台灣、中國、東南亞地區的產能佈局與精實生產，並發揮靈活調度優勢，不僅有效維持優異的生產效率與產品良率，亦能迅速響應品牌客戶的急單與彈性拉貨需求，發揮強大的供應鏈管理韌性。
展望2026年第四季，伸興對整體營運發展保持審慎態度。隨著第四季持續迎來傳統多元產業需求，加上縫紉機在中高階機種出貨比重提升與全球產能彈性調度的優勢，公司有信心推升下半年營運效益，帶動2026全年整體營運規模與績效繳出良好的成績單。
paras_en: Shenxing (1558‑TW) announced that its consolidated revenue for September 2026 reached NT$968 million, up 8.81% month‑over‑month and 29.19% year‑over‑year, marking the highest monthly revenue this year; the third‑quarter consolidated revenue was NT$2.795 billion, up 21.95% quarter‑over‑quarter and 24.31% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months totaled NT$7.013 billion, an 8.35% increase year‑over‑year. Benefiting from stronger pull‑forward orders from major customers and seasonal industry effects, the solid order‑growth foundation helps maintain a positive growth momentum for the year’s overall operations.

Shenxing noted that the second to third quarters are the traditional shipping peak season for the household sewing‑machine industry, mainly driven by replenishment demand ahead of holiday shopping seasons such as Christmas and Thanksgiving in Europe and the United States. As inventory health in end‑retail channels continues to improve, major international sewing‑machine brands are actively stocking up, boosting the company’s household sewing‑machine shipments sharply in September.

Beyond the usual seasonal boost, the recent global DIY craft culture, customized apparel, and personalized textile trends have kept demand for mid‑to‑high‑end household sewing machines and multifunctional electric sewing machines strong. Leveraging its superior R&D and manufacturing capabilities, Shenxing has helped customers launch models with smart and user‑friendly features, effectively capturing market trends and injecting further growth momentum into overall operations, supporting a healthy order outlook.

Facing the challenges of global supply‑chain restructuring and rapid market changes, Shenxing continues to refine its capacity layout and lean production in Taiwan, China and Southeast Asia, and to exploit flexible scheduling advantages. This not only sustains high production efficiency and product yield, but also enables rapid response to urgent orders and flexible pull‑forward requests from brand customers, demonstrating strong supply‑chain resilience.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter of 2026, Shenxing maintains a cautious stance on overall operational development. With the quarter expected to bring continued diversified industry demand, an increasing share of mid‑to‑high‑end sewing‑machine shipments, and the advantage of flexible global capacity scheduling, the company is confident it can lift second‑half performance and deliver a solid full‑year operational scale and results.
